page: UpCloud PREMIUM-80xCPU-512GB is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the Premium family. It features 80 physical cores and 80 vCPUs powered by an AMD EPYC 9575F processor running at 2.0 GHz with a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing 6.4 GB of memory per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 500 GB SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier performance, particularly in multi-core processing and memory bandwidth. The stress-ng multi-core CPU test and Geekbench multi-core score both rank in the top 10%, alongside high-throughput capabilities in software compilation, ray tracing, and text processing. Single-core performance is also strong, with Geekbench single-core and stress-ng single-core scores placing in the top 10% and top 25% respectively. Cryptographic operations and database tasks perform exceptionally well, as evidenced by top-tier Passmark encryption and strong Passmark database operations scores.

While the server excels in raw compute and memory bandwidth, it exhibits limitations in specific workloads. Large-block memory write speeds and static web serving throughput are strong but do not reach the top-tier level of its multi-core compute. Furthermore, LLM inference text generation speeds for small and medium models are weak, placing in the bottom 25%, indicating that CPU-based text generation is a bottleneck. This hardware profile is highly suited for compute-heavy applications, software compilation, database operations, and high-concurrency web serving, but less optimal for real-time LLM text generation.
